usedFor: Solve CRM holds contacts and companies, and HubSpot holds deals, so “New Tagged Contact” can run “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Tagged Contact” in Solve CRM, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Tagging a contact opens a deal, so you choose which contacts reach the pipeline.

watchOut: “Update Contact” in Solve CRM fires on every update, so the same contact can create several deals.
